required.name: P25_DATA_V1 TRAIN
required.digest_contract: existing ProofTargets content digest verified by load_working_split, not an assumed raw-file SHA256
required.partition_rule: SHA256(v4_train_dev_v1| + canon), first eight bytes big-endian u64 modulo 10: zero DEV, otherwise FIT

regeneration_permitted_only_if: documented recipe, all required exclusion artifacts, and exact expected content digest are available
local_recheck_scope: matching proof-train JSON filenames under Desktop, Documents and Downloads; documented paths in both worktrees
github_recheck_scope: accepted source commit pull-request-triggered workflow runs returned an empty list; not an exhaustive repository artifact inventory
